scope: Local only; 45 refinements of existing Art Room tools. No new artwork binaries, service, publication or saved-personal schema migration.

improvements.title: Shareable drawing searches
improvements.implementation: useArtFinderUrl + ArtPaperFinder retain sheetQuery/sheetGroup in the URL.

improvements.title: Shareable visit selections
improvements.implementation: ArtVisitChooser retains visitQuery/visitGroup in the URL.

improvements.title: Return to a drawing result
improvements.implementation: ArtPaperSelectionNav focuses the exact matching result and retains the search.

improvements.title: Browse a drawing selection
improvements.implementation: Previous/Next links follow the filtered paper-object sequence.

improvements.title: Chronological gallery order
improvements.implementation: Earliest/latest use the first recorded year; original uncertain date labels are retained and unknown dates sort last.

improvements.title: Painter-name gallery order
improvements.implementation: Painter A–Z is an optional URL-persisted order; curated order remains default.

improvements.title: Responsive facet counts
improvements.implementation: Painter/era/subject/mood options count matches under the other current choices.

improvements.title: Explain drawing matches
improvements.implementation: Results identify matching title, maker, material or combined-record text.

improvements.title: Whole-image overview
improvements.implementation: The enlarged viewer includes a proportional whole-image map with a viewport rectangle.

improvements.title: Zoom around an inspected point
improvements.implementation: Controls preserve the view center; pinch magnification anchors at the touch midpoint.

improvements.title: Preserve center on resize
improvements.implementation: ResizeObserver and normalized center coordinates preserve the inspected area across viewport changes.

improvements.title: Resolution indicator
improvements.implementation: Shows displayed CSS dimensions against actual source pixels; explicitly distinguishes screen density and new detail.

improvements.title: Hide fullscreen controls
improvements.implementation: A persistent show/hide control restores the toolbar; Escape continues to close the viewer.

improvements.title: Detail-view links
improvements.implementation: Copy canonical work URLs with bounded magnification/position, including a separately identified verso where available.

improvements.title: Deliberate last-detail return
improvements.implementation: Tab-local image position offers an explicit return action; ordinary opening still fits the whole image.

improvements.title: Swap comparison sides
improvements.implementation: Swaps works and their independent views while respecting the existing unsaved-writing guard.

improvements.title: Independent comparison magnifications
improvements.implementation: Each side retains its own bounded position/scale and survives view switching.

improvements.title: Named suggested comparisons
improvements.implementation: Visible buttons use the actual editorial comparison question instead of numbered Pair labels.

improvements.title: Comparison selection summary
improvements.implementation: First/second titles appear near the viewing controls.

improvements.title: Complete comparison-view sharing
improvements.implementation: Explicit copy action includes pair, lens, visible sides, independent views or shared detail/physical-size mode, without writing.

improvements.title: Search notebook writing
improvements.implementation: Search existing saved notes, before/after reflections and detail observations, with shared normalization.

improvements.title: Notebook writing-type filters
improvements.implementation: Choose personal notes, reflections or detail observations, combined with the existing collection filter.

improvements.title: Exact matching notebook text
improvements.implementation: Contextual snippets and safe React mark elements reveal distant matches; opening a result scrolls to its first marked passage.

improvements.title: Saved paintings by collection
improvements.implementation: My Art can show the saved subset belonging to a collection without modifying memberships.

improvements.title: Duplicate a collection
improvements.implementation: Unique named copy preserves the original IDs, sequence and introduction; collection limits remain enforced.

improvements.title: Direct exhibition positioning
improvements.implementation: Position selector moves a work directly, retaining the existing Earlier/Later controls.

improvements.title: Undo a sequence move
improvements.implementation: Restores the prior sequence only if a newer order has not superseded it.

improvements.title: Exhibition introduction recovery
improvements.implementation: Separate bounded drafts recover after reload and detect newer saved introductions; Save remains explicit.

improvements.title: Per-entry restore decisions
improvements.implementation: Conflicts in notes, passages, arguments, reflection fields, detail notes, comparison notes, collection names/introductions and reading positions require choices.

improvements.title: Restore change preview
improvements.implementation: Lists identical, additive/new and conflicting entries; a concurrently changed browser copy invalidates the preview before writing.

improvements.title: Search museum-guide choices
improvements.implementation: Title/painter search shares catalog normalization and aliases.

improvements.title: Guide from personal collection
improvements.implementation: Explicitly select the first six works; larger collections receive a clear limit message and saved collections remain untouched.

improvements.title: Retain an unfinished guide
improvements.implementation: Validated tab-local stop IDs, order, grouping and print layout survive refresh and returning from a study.

improvements.title: Two print layouts
improvements.implementation: Compact reference layout or spacious note-taking layout, using the existing print flow.

improvements.title: Print page breaks
improvements.implementation: Artwork records, questions and note spaces avoid breaking apart, with dedicated print CSS.

improvements.title: Mixed-institution guide clarity
improvements.implementation: Identifies multi-collection selections and optionally groups printed stops by collection without promising current display.

improvements.title: Formatted study citation
improvements.implementation: Copy editorial title, edition, canonical URL and actual consultation date; no invented personal author.

improvements.title: RIS / BibTeX export
improvements.implementation: Select essay references for local exports; unknown publication/author fields remain absent.

improvements.title: Institutional identifiers
improvements.implementation: Three painting numbers newly checked against institutional pages; existing 24 paper accession records retained. No URL IDs are inferred as accession numbers.

improvements.title: Catalog abbreviation help
improvements.implementation: Existing object-literacy guide explains inventory/accession/catalog numbers and catalogue-raisonné edition context.

improvements.title: Separate editorial and reference dates
improvements.implementation: Essay sources distinguish edition, editorial-review date, object-metadata check and consultation date; unavailable first-publication date is stated as unrecorded.

improvements.title: Corrections linked to discussion
improvements.implementation: Current correction records link to affected existing essay sections when an identifiable passage exists; older change entries retain source and study routes.

improvements.title: Browser-reading speed
improvements.implementation: Five supported rate choices, with a clear stop-on-change behavior.

improvements.title: Browser voice selection
improvements.implementation: Available voice list reacts to voiceschanged; identifies device voices without claiming every voice is local.

improvements.title: Section audio playback
improvements.implementation: Readable complete transcript segmented without dropping text; section playback, previous/next and continuous introduction playback.

affectedBrowserFollowup.note: Reruns after presentation fixes, not 30 additional unique tests.

finalStyleFollowup.note: After two final CSS overrides; repeat checks, not new unique tests.
